input.title: Retain authored loading, field weapons and captured win state
input.body:
## Summary

Upgrade screens recreated previews across child menus, cross-field weapons lost ownership or chose fighters too late, and the win view used CSS blur after completion had changed the scene. This five-layer batch restores the recovered loading, weapon and captured-screen contracts.

```text
loading slots → retained preview/menu lifetime
weapon Setup → cached fighter choice → outgoing births / retained old-layer beams
completion notification → one captured win bitmap → direct Continue or fresh menu
```

This is the last combined PR, targeting master. Its head contains every head from [#130](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/130), [#131](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/131), [#132](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/132) and [#133](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/133) by verified ancestry. Those PRs provide focused layer reviews; land the batch through this PR once its current-head gate passes.

The fifth layer proves a valid Shield Turrets creator/save/local-enemy caller and records two source objections: cached attachment overwrites its target with the avatar, and a rejected birth returns an unparented object. It deliberately adds no turret simulation fix. The separately prepared field-wave correction is outside this tree.

## Evidence

- **Before:** cross-field beam/boss and Setup-order regressions failed; win capture happened after field-tail writes.
  **After:** formatting, TypeScript and all 915 unit tests / 8,458 assertions pass on the combined tree.
